verdict.rationale: YYLO isolates agent work in dedicated task worktrees and queues committed candidates for managed merging. No evidence shows a documented step where a developer views a diff of the agent's changes and explicitly approves it before a pull request is created. The pack says reviews are explicit project checks kept outside merge, and inspecting the worktree with git would be a user-side workaround, not a product capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review a diff of an agent's changes and approve it before it becomes a pull request
